title: Fake video about Zelenskyy’s parents – level 1
paragraphs: A popular video on the internet tells a bad story about President Zelenskyy’s parents. It says that they take a lot of money illegally.

This story is fake. The creators use a logo from a real news company, but the news company does not make it. The voice in the video comes from a computer. Officials say that Russian teams make this fake video to start more problems for Ukraine. They want other countries to stop helping Ukraine.
Fact-checkers already check many stories like this in the past. There are many similar videos which want to hurt Ukraine.

words.d: a person or group which comes up with something new
a person or team who checks if information is correct and true
